statements.subject: server
statements.description: To minimize impact on playback in any of the above cases, the server MUST modify the playback properties, set scale to a supportable value, and continue delivery of the media. When doing this modification, it MUST send a PLAY_NOTIFY message with the Notify-Reason header set to 'scale-change'.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: C->S: RTSP/2.0 200 OK in response to PLAY_NOTIFY with Notify-Reason scale-change.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: When doing this modification, it MUST send a PLAY_NOTIFY message with the Notify-Reason header set to 'scale-change'.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The request MUST contain a Range header with the media time when the change took effect, a Scale header with the new value in use, a Session header with the identifier for the session to which it applies, and a Date header with the server wallclock time of the change.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The request MUST contain a Scale header with the new value in use.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: For media streams delivered using RTP, an RTP-Info header MUST also be included. It MUST contain the rtptime parameter with a value corresponding to the point of change in that media and optionally the sequence number.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: For time-progressing content, the Media-Range and the Media-Properties headers at this point in time also MUST be included.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: A PLAY_NOTIFY request with Notify-Reason header set to 'Scale-Change' MUST NOT carry a message body.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: PLAY_NOTIFY requests for aggregated sessions MUST use the aggregated control URI in the request. The scale change for any aggregated session applies to all media streams that are part of the aggregate.
actions: send PLAY_NOTIFY using aggregated control URI
apply scale change to all aggregate media streams
